༁ྃ:yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las:gdug pa 'dul byed khro rgyal khyung gi phyi nang gsang gsum sgrub skor las sbyor dang bcas pa bzhugs so:

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las: gdug pa 'dul byed khro rgyal khyung gi phyi nang gsang gsum sgrub skor las sbyor dang bcas pa bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ gdug pa 'dul ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las: nam mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs ston pa ni: thugs kyi rgyud rdo rje pad+mo'i drwa ba can las: de nas yang dag bshad bya ba: nyid las mi gzhan rab sprul pa'i: dpa' bo dbang ni nam mkha' lding: mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa bar gsungs: zhes gsungs pas: 'di la phyi sgrub dang: nang sgrub: gsang sgrub gsum las: dang po phyi sgrub ni: bcas sogs nang sgrub ltar: rigs gsum khyung lnga'i sgrub thabs ltar byas nas: dang po bsnyen pa ni: chos rnams thams cad stong par bsam: stong pa'i ngang las 'byung rim brtsegs: ri mtsho bdun dbus ri rab steng: gzhal yas khang ni 'od phung 'bar: dbus su pad nyi klu 'bum steng: bdag nyid yi ge khroṃ du gyur: de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: khroṃ: ye shes las byung bya khyung ni: sku mdog dkar la 'dab gshog dmar: zhal ni gsum dang ldan pa ste: phyag ni drug gi rnam pa can: g.yas kyi phyag ni gsum pa la: rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che: g.yon pa gsum na 'dzin pa ni: pad+ma rgya gram sbrul du 'dzin: rwa ni thabs dang shes rab ste: chos kyi sku ni nor bu yin: 'dab gshog ral gri spu gri 'bar: sder mo rdo rje pha lam grub: spyan mig nyi ma zla bar 'khyil: spu ni rin chen nor bu 'bar: bya khyung rigs lnga 'khor bcas gsal: thugs kar khroṃ mthar sngags 'di 'khor: ye shes me dpung rab tu 'bar: khro chu khol mas gtams par bsam: oṃ khroṃ rā dza ma hā ga ru ṭa swā hā: zhes pa rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa ste: 'bum phrag gsum du bzlas pas 'grub: gnyis pa bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni: ting nge 'dzin ni gong des chog: sgrub pa'i snying po 'di nyid bzla: oṃ khroṃ rā dza ma hā ga ru ṭa nā ga hṛ da ya: bha ga ba ti ma hā kro ta h+ya grī ba hūm̐ sap+ta ba ta la sarba karma bh+ya tiṣaṇ+ṭa ut+pa bi nan:

tad+ya thā: ha na ha na: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: ma ra ma ra: du na du na: s+pho ta s+pho ta: bak+sha ni bak+sha ni: nā ga sa man+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: khri phrag bzlas pas las kun 'grub: klu rnams rang bzhin dbang du 'dus: gdug pa can gyi srog dang bral: mdze ni chu bur song yang sos: gzhan gyi nad la smros mi 'tshal: khyad par snying nad ma lus sel: rjes su bstod pa bya ba ni: hrī: pad+ma dbang chen rta mchog dpal: snang ba mtha' yas he ru ka: ye shes las byung ga ru ṭa: zhal ni gsum ste sku gsum dngos: rwa ni drug ste rigs drug 'dul: rwa bar nor bu chos kyi sku: phyag drug mtshon chas klu gdon 'joms: 'dab gshog skyod pas dbang yin te: sder mo bgrad pas phrin las yin: sku mdog dkar la zhi ba ste: spyan rtsa ser la rgyas pa'i las: phrin las bzhi yi bdag nyid la: mchod cing bstod do phrin las mdzod: ces brjod klu sman bdud rtsi dang: gtor ma tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod: phyi sgrub rim pa sa ma ya: dam rgya: de nas gnyis pa nang sgrub ni: bca' thabs nang sgrub nag po klu 'dul ltar byas nas: ting nge 'dzin ni: bdag nyid skad cig khroṃ las byung ba'i bya khyung sku mdog dmar la 'dab gshog mthing ga: dbu gsum g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar ze ba dang dbu sgro me ltar 'bar ba: phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che 'bar ba bsnams pa: g.yon gsum pad+ma rdo rje rgya gram sbrul lnga zhal du 'dzud pa'i rked par 'dzin pa: zhabs gnyis ka klu rigs bzhi'i snying gar brdzis nas sbrul stong gnyan khri gnon pa: sku la rin po ches brgyan cing: rwa dang sder mo gnam lcags las grub pa: rwa bar yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs pa'i nang du sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs pa: ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i phyogs bzhi la: rigs bzhi'i khyung dkar ser dmar ljang gi mdog dang ldan cing:

zhal gcig phyag gnyis rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan dang sbrul mgo zhal du gzud nas bsnams pa: rang 'dra'i sprul pa yan lag lnga 'gyed par bsam: kun gyi thugs kar hrīḥdamar mthar sngags 'dis 'khor bar bsam la bsnyen pa khri phrag 'bul: oṃ hrīḥkhroṃ ga ru ṭaḥtsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: hrīḥnā ga sarba tsakra mā ra ya dza: de nas gnyis pa sgrub pa ni: bdag nyid rta mgrin bya khyung gi rnam par gsal la: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro ta h+ya grī ba hūm̐: hu lu hu lu nā ga: hu ya hu ya nā ga: dā ra dā ra nā ga: bi dā ra bi dā ra nā ga: tshin+dha tshin+dha nā ga: bhin+dha bhin+dha nā ga: ha na ha na nā ga: da ha da ha nā ga: pa tsa pa tsa nā ga: gardza gardza nā ga: s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa nā ga: bi s+pho ta bi s+pho ta nā ga: bhan+dha bhan+dha nā ga: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha nā ga: s+phu ta s+phu ta nā ga: tsa la tsa la nā ga: a tsa la a tsa la nā ga: a tsa le a tsa le nā ga: du ru du ru nā ga: phaṭa raṃ phaṭa raṃ nā ga: dz+wa la dz+wa la nā ga: trag phaṭa trag phaṭa nā ga: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: nā ga ni bhi ta na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: tsi li ba su ki hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: mi li mi li nā ga rā tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: sid+dhi sid+dhi nā ga sa man+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: ha sa ha sa nā ga bak+ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: mā ra mā ra nā ga pa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: ha ra ha ra nā ga pra sa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: zhes pa stong bzlas klu nad zhi: khri bzlas klu chen brgyad kyang 'dul: 'bum bzlas dbang chen nyid dang mnyam: rtags ni bsam gyis mi khyab 'byung: las sbyor phur bu btab pa'i sngags: hrīḥkhroṃ e ka tsā ti gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya bh+yo dza: trag rak+sha ma ma hrīḥyaṃ dza: ces de las sbyor drag po'i sngags: thun dang dgug dang dbye ba dang: bsreg mnan gsad pa'i las kun 'grub: shin tu zab bo gsang zhig rgya: : sa ma ya:

rgya rgya rgya: dam rgya: de nas gsum pa gsang sgrub ni: gsang ba'i nang nas yang gsang mchog: dpa' bo dbang dang dbyer med pa'i: nam mkha' lding gi sgrub pa brtsam: dang po bsam gtan ting 'dzin ni: hrī: chos nyid rnam dag bde chen ngang las ni: ma rtogs sems can thugs rjes bsgral ba'i phyir: drag po'i zhe sdang hrīḥyig 'phro 'du 'bar: 'du 'phro rtog pa'i dug lnga sel ba'i phyir: zhe sdang chos 'byung gru gsum e yi ngang: phrag dog rlung nag rdo rje rgya gram 'tshubs: 'dod chags rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrugs pa las: gti mug māṃ sa'i sa gzhi gcal du bkod: nga rgyal ri rab gru gsum me yis brjid: rgya gram rdo rje ra gur 'bar ba'i dbus: smug nag bh+rūm̐ las 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang: rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas chen po: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi yis mdzes: rin chen sna lnga brtsegs pa'i rā ga la: dbang po rnams kyi dra ba dra phyed ldan: zhing chen ka gdung zhing chung dral drab can: lhun gyis grub pa'i nyi zla'i rang bzhin 'bar: zhing lpags bla re sbrul gyi za ra tshags: zhing gi rgyal mtshan mdzes pa'i 'phur lce'u 'bar: g.yer kha'i dra ba pad+ma'i dbyug pas mdzes: spu gri tri shul gtun shing srin mo 'gros: dur khrod brgyad dang me yi dra ba ris: de dbus thod pa tshar gsum rtsig par brtsegs: gru gsum pho brang 'bar ba'i maṇ+ḍal la: chos nyid skye med ye shes 'char ba'i sgo: rab 'byams gzhal yas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: dbang chen mkha' lding lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i gnas: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dz+nyā na tsakra e bh+rūm̐: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal: ba ru ṇa: phu ti ra baṃ: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal hūm̐: de nas lha gsal ba ni: hrīḥlas 'du 'phro bskul don gnyis: tshur 'dus bdag nyid dpa' bo dbang: zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa ste: g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus mthing zhal: phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje ste: g.yon pa'i dang po zhags pa 'o:

bar ma gnyis kyis rigs ngan za: tha mas mkha' lding ljang gu 'phyar: rdo rje rin chen gshog pa brgyangs: mthing nag sku la dur khrod rgyan: zhabs ni klu 'bum gnyan khri dang: sa bdag stong bsnol gdan la bgrad: ri rab lta bu'i skur gsal ba'i: snying gar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng: baṃ las rgya mtsho bsam par bya: de ru mkha' lding bsgom par bya: trāṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje ste: baṃ yig las byung rgya mtsho'i dbus: trāṃ las ri rab chen po ste: gru bzhi rin chen ngo bo la: de steng khroṃ las nam mkha' lding: sku ni shel gyi mdog can la: bai ḍūr+ya yi 'dab gshog can: gnam lcags ra ni 'od du 'bar: spyan bgrad zhal ni gcig pa ste: phyag na zhe sdang sbrul bzung nas: zhal du gsol ba'i dregs pa can: dpral bar rdo rje'i khyung dkar dang: mgrin par pad+ma'i khyung dmar dang: thugs kar bud+dha'i khyung mthing gsal: lte bar yon tan khyung ser la: gsang bar phrin las khyung ljang rnams: cha lugs phyag mtshan gtso bo ltar: sprul pa yang sprul grangs med pas: rigs bzhi'i klu rnams za bar bsgom: ma yengs drag pos sngags 'di bzla: oṃ badz+ra ga ru ṇaḥh+ya grī ba hūm̐: srog tshig nan rbad lus rdul rbad: nā ga mā ra ya zhi zhi raṃ raṃ lus rdul phung rbad sod: de bzlas rtags kyi rim pa ni: me 'bar chu skam chu gnas bsad: rgya mtsho skem dang ri bsnyil zhing: nya lcong sbal dang sbrul bsad cing: khyung dang dbang chen zhal mjal nas: rigs bzhi'i klu rnams thang la lhags: nad rnying dag cing nus pa 'bar: klu gdon sa bdag gnyan kun gyi: gnyen po tho ba lta bur 'gyur: mdze dang phol mig nad can gyis: gong gi sngags sham 'di nyid gdags: laṃ baṃ raṃ yaṃ a ni nā ga mā ra ya shig shig swā hā: des ni mdze nad sel ba dang: klu yi dug ni med par 'gyur: sa ma ya: : gu h+ya: gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni: dang po 'khor lo bca' ba ni: shog gu gro ga ras sogs la:

'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud ldan: lte bar khroṃ la rtsa sngags bskor: rtsibs la laṃ baṃ raṃ yaṃ bzhi la: rtsibs mchan la: shar nas brtsam ste rim pa bzhin: a ghi phu: ma si phu: mṛ ti phu: du ra phu: zhes bris las dkyil gru gsum gzhug: dgug gzhug bya zhing gnod byed bstim: ting 'dzin ldan pas bsnyen pa 'bul: 'khor lo drag por 'khor ba las: rtsibs mchan btson dong klu rigs bzhi: 'khor lo mtshon chas gtubs pa la: skyong gi 'khor lo bskor ba ltar: sha gzhob nyil nyil bsad par bsam: thun brab drag sngags bzlas gyur na: sa bdag klu gnyan gang yin kyang: 'chi bar gyur par the tshom med: 'di ni zab pas gsang bar bya: : gnyis pa ser ba bsrung ba ni: bdag nyid dbang drag khyung du bsgom: dbang gi dkyil 'khor lus la bsgom: thal chen yungs dkar ser bar gtor: nam mkha' me dang khro bcur gyur: ser bdag bsad nas ser ba rnams: me yis chu ru bzhus par bsam: drag sngags 'di yis bsdigs par bsam: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro ta h+ya grī ba hūm̐: hu lu hu lu: hu ya hu ya: da ra da ra: bhi da ra bhi da ra: tshin+dha tshin+dha: bhin+dha bhin+dha: ha na ha na: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: kha kha khā hi khā hi: s+pho ta s+pho ta: gardza gardza: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha: dz+wa la ya dz+wa la ya: dhu ru dhu ru: phaṭa raṃ phaṭa raṃ: dz+wa la raṃ: zhes gdab pas ser ba chu ru 'gyur ro: : gzhan gyi rbod gtong byad gtad dang: sa bdag sde brgyad gnod pa kun: bzlog par 'dod pa'i gang zag de: 'du 'dzi med pa'i gnas su 'gro: sa stegs mda' gang gru bzhi brtsegs: dbus su khru gang gru gsum bru: gru gsum nang du nag po bzhag: de steng 'gro med sa gtsang la: khru gang mchod rten legs par bca': bum pa pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: chos 'khor tog dang bre la sogs: sbrul gnyis dar dpyang tshul du bya: rgya mtshal byugs nas dmar por bya: srung ba'i 'khor lo bum par sba: 'od dpag med ni bre nang gzhug:

bdag gzhan bsrung bya bum dbus gzhug: rab gnas tshad ldan legs par bya: de 'og gru gsum brub khung der: dur khrod grog mkhar sa dag la: mchod rten nag po khru gang dbyibs: sum rim me chu rlung ris bya: de bar gser gyi sa gzhi la: gru bzhi lam dang rdo rjes mtshan: mchod rten gru gsum e dbyibs thun khung byed: gri shi rabs chad gang rung rkang: thun sbubs mgrin lam bde bar byas: sbug bkag phur pa dag gis bya: mchod rten gcig la rab gnas bya: ro ras dug shog gang rung la: liṅga dbang po tshang ba bri: lce zheng brang la sleb par bya: lce la sngags 'di dgod par bya: oṃ h+ya grī ba wā ka s+t+wam+bha ku ru laṃ nan: s+t+wam+bha s+t+wam+bha: mo ha mo ha: ga ya ga ya: hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: de bris sa sna'i ling gzugs bcos: de yi snying kar ming rus bri: gnas bdun sa la rak+tas sbrus: sor bdun tshad bcas mchod rten gzhug: de steng zlog pa'i 'khor lo ni: rtsibs bcu dbus su zlum po bya: zlum dbus pu ri'i mchod rten bya: lte bar khroṃ dang hrīḥbakod la: phyi nas zlog pa'i sngags kyis bskor: de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la: hūm̐ bcu mgo ni nang du bstan: 'khor rtse lcags kyi bya khyung bcu: phyir bstan rngams pa'i tshul du bya: 'khor lo'i phyi na mu khyud spang: me dang mtshon cha bris kyang chog: rtsibs mchan liṅga re re bri: snying gar dmigs bya'i ming rus bri: mchod rten 'og ma'i steng du 'am: dkar po'i rmang la brgyangs nas bzhag: de nas rang nyid rta mgrin khyung: gnyis med bsams nas sngags 'di bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī ba hu lu hu lu: ma ma ṭā+e ta dz+ye nā gi no sarba pa ta nan: ma hā ba de lo tad+ya thā: ku ru ku ru: tsu ru tsu ru: mu ru mu ru: ha na ha na: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: byi dang sa byi dang sa: ṣa ṭa ṣa ṭa: sa ha sa ha: sha ta sa ha: pra bi tsu ra ṇa bi ta na sa: pra t+yaṃ gi ra:

ma ma pra ya: tsa na ma hi tad da badz+ra kro ta maṃ hi lo ka da ra badz+ri ha sa ya na: ha ha ho shrī kra ka ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: de ltar bzlas pa'i ting 'dzin ni: bdag nyid rta mgrin mkha' lding gsal: gdan 'og mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'khor: 'ur 'ur drag tu 'khor ba las: me dang mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs: khro chung bya khyung grangs med 'phros: stong gsum gang nas byad ma rnams: 'khor lo'i rtsibs la bskyon nas bsad: sha gzhob nyil nyil btang bar bsam: zhag bdun bsgrubs pas nges par bzlog: de yang rgyud phyi ma stong gsum za byed las: e ma ho: 'di ni mchog tu gsang ba ste: rnal 'byor pa yis nan tan bya: bdag la gzhan zhig rigs sngags kyi: nye bar 'tshe ba gang brtsams pa: klu rnams nyes par bsgrubs pa ltar: de kun rang la ldog par 'gyur: rang gis byas pa'i lha gang gi: rang la des ni gnod par nges: sbrul gdug gsos pa nyes pa 'am: dza ya ga to 'phrad pa ltar: rang nyid brlag par gdon mi za: rang nyid sbyor ngan byas pa kun: lcags bsregs la ni ras bal mtshungs: nam mkha' la ni btegs pa ltar: rang gi ngag rnams rengs par 'gyur: ces gsungs pas: 'di ltar sbyor ba brtsams pa tsam gyis 'grub: sngags dang ting 'dzin ldan na smros ci dgos: rdo rje pha lam lta bu'i las sbyor ro: sa ma ya: : gu h+ya: zab rgya: gtor 'bul mchod bstod bya ba ni: nang sgrub klu 'dul ltar bya: yang na las gzhung gang rigs gtang: bdag 'dra o rgyan pad+ma ngas: rta mchog rol rgyud chen po nas: gdug pa 'dul ba'i las phran rnams: zab bsdus bcud dril snying thig 'di: spel phangs rin chen gter du sbas: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: : zab rgya: sku gsung thugs kyi rgya yod: ྈྈྈ
stag sham nus ldan rdo rjes dga' ba lung gi tshal nas rnyed pa'o/// /
